text:
darya: Quick note from the starter smoke test: the next-langchain-mini template sometimes issues two embedding requests on first load (hydration + client fetch). curious if we should teach the SDK to expose an idempotency key for embeddings.

mike: saw that too. client hydration fires then a small background prewarm also calls /api/embed. currently no idempotency so both bill.

jules: short-term hack: set a sessionStorage flag before client fetch and skip if present. ugly but effective for demos.

darya: can we add opt-in header x-redwood-idempotency for embedding calls so server can dedupe within 5s? would solve races without client hacks.

mike: sounds good. also lower browser retry aggressiveness by default so a 429 doesn't immediately spin repeated calls during hydration.

jules: i'll open a tiny SDK PR: (1) add optional idempotency header support in embeddings client, (2) change browser default retry policy to backoff with jitter and a smaller cap, (3) add a cookbook snippet in the template README.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-981 "embed idempotency + browser retry defaults" assigned to jules.
